sideout · Valencia City

Privacy notice

Sideout is a pickleball community website for Valencia City, Bukidnon. This notice describes the information used by its current website features. Contact the Sideout operator at hoyjoshi@gmail.com with questions or requests about your information.

Information Sideout uses

  • Sign-in information: an account identifier, name, profile picture and email address when available from the sign-in provider, plus authentication information managed by Supabase. Google sign-in is supported; Facebook sign-in uses the same account service when available. Sideout’s Facebook login requests basic profile access and email. Your Google or Facebook password is entered with that provider, not into a Sideout password form.
  • Your player: your chosen display name, player code, pixel character, chosen height and body type, hairstyle and colors, clothing, and equipment.
  • Your games: MMR, games played, wins, duo membership and invitations, match participants, results, who submitted the result, rating changes, and related timestamps. Match records include a snapshot of the players’ names, avatars, and ratings at the time of the match.
  • Optional court check-ins: the court you select, Playing / Idle / Practice status, whether you are available for open play, and check-in, update, and expiry times. This feature uses the court you choose; the website does not request GPS location for check-ins.
  • Browser session information: Supabase saves authentication session information in your browser so you can stay signed in and renew your session.

Sideout uses this information to sign you in, save your character, connect players and duos, record games, calculate ratings, show the leaderboard, and display optional court activity.

What other players can see

Other signed-in players can see your player name, code, character and its chosen attributes, rating, games, and wins through features such as player lookup, duos, the leaderboard, and court rosters. Match participants can see their match records and the player snapshots in them. The player views returned to other players do not include your sign-in email.

When you check in, your selected court, character, rating, status, and open-play choice appear to signed-in players. A check-in stops appearing as active two hours after its latest update. Updating it starts a new two-hour visibility period. Use Leave court to remove your current check-in sooner. These are self-reported check-ins, not proof of someone’s physical location.

Your player QR contains a link to your player code. A duo invite QR contains a one-use invite link that can pair its recipient with you after sign-in and avatar setup. Give duo invite links only to your intended teammate.

Camera, QR photos, and story cards

If you choose camera scanning, your browser asks for camera permission. QR camera frames and selected QR photos are decoded in the browser; Sideout’s scanner does not upload those images. The decoded player code or invite is then used to look up the player or join the duo through the account service. You can also paste a code or link.

Story cards are rendered as images in your browser. Downloading saves a copy to your device. Sharing passes the image to your device’s share menu and the app you choose. A story card includes your player name, character, and rating. Copies you share to Instagram, Facebook, or another service are controlled by that service and the people who receive them.

Services involved

Vercel hosts the current website. Supabase provides authentication and stores the player, duo, match, and court data. Google and, when enabled, Facebook handle their respective sign-in steps. These services receive the requests needed to provide their functions.

The website loads fonts from Google Fonts. Choosing Get directions opens Google Maps. Signing in, opening external links, or sharing an image can take you to a service with its own privacy practices.

Storage and deletion

Account, profile, and game records are stored in Supabase. The current application does not set a general automatic deletion schedule for these records. Expiry of an invitation or court check-in controls whether it is usable or shown as active; expiry alone does not mean its database record has been deleted. The current check-in is removed when you use Leave court, and a later check-in can replace it.

You can edit your name and character in the website, leave your current duo or court, and sign out. Signing out or removing Sideout from Facebook’s connected apps does not itself delete Sideout’s stored player and game data. See data deletion instructions to request deletion from the operator.

After verifying an account deletion request, the operator removes the account and its associated live player, avatar, court, invitation and duo records. Affected match records, including saved names and character snapshots, are removed for all participants. Other players’ current rating, games and win totals remain unchanged. This process covers live application data; it does not promise immediate removal from service-provider backups, security or audit logs, or separate request correspondence.

Sideout cannot remove copies of story cards or information that someone has separately downloaded or posted on another service. Requests about those copies should also go to the relevant recipient or service.
